customManagers.description: The UCS patch levels of the ucs-base-python images that the replacement rules below move the Dockerfiles to (one per UCS release)

packageRules.description: Generated from uv.lock by the uv-export pre-commit hook
Every UCS release has its own ucs-base-python image, the image must never move to another release

Every UCS patch level has its own ucs-base-python image, so the docker manager cannot find the next one. Renovate keeps the tag and looks the digest up in the new image, and skips the replacement until the new image has that tag. UCS 5.2 (the Kelvin image).
As above, for UCS 5.3 (the connector builder, which must match the Debian trixie Python of the CCF image).
